scenes.say: Picture this. The federal solar tax credit is gone.
Is there any money left for going solar?

lines: have their own credits or rebates.
scenes.say: Yes. About a dozen states offer their own solar tax credits or rebates.
New York's twenty-five percent credit, up to five thousand dollars, is one of the strongest.
In states like New Jersey, Massachusetts, and Illinois, programs pay you for the power you produce.
And property and sales tax exemptions quietly save hundreds to thousands of dollars.
Want to see your state's incentives? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
